body:
simdesign-gaugebudget: companion to simdesign-gaugescatter (landed by a parallel run under the slug I had claimed, so renamed). Runs the laser-cutting rules search under the peak stress at two search budgets and keeps per-gauge results. The scatter sits in the 2 mm gauge; a ~4x budget cuts the price sd from 0.063 to 0.025, non-monotonically. Stylised, five seeds. 8 tests pass; `python site/build.py` prints ok.
